Our Norms on Security, Science Communication and Conflicts of Interest

https://www.apolloresearch.ai/blog/our-norms-coi-security-science-communication/

Four COI rules: no contingent compensation; no side grants/investments from evaluated orgs; recusal; no misrepresentation. States labs pay fair market value.
